one_line: New US chip restrictions and supply shortages disrupt global AI infrastructure, hardware deliveries, and data center financing.

themes.title: Export controls and shortages strain hardware
themes.text: New U.S. export controls have halted server shipments to Southeast Asia and stalled billions in data center loans tied to Chinese firms. Meanwhile, severe memory shortages have driven up prices tenfold and extended lead times for Nvidia's B300 chips up to 40 weeks, while S&P considers a credit downgrade for Nvidia over governance risks.

stories.headline: Pentagon officials discussed using Defense Production Act over Nvidia CEO role
S&P considers Nvidia credit downgrade over governance risks
US chip curbs stall billions in data center loans tied to Chinese firms
Nvidia stops shipping AI servers to four Southeast Asian countries
NVIDIA B300 AI chip orders face up to 40‑week wait; RTX 60 GPU may slip past 2027
Memory chip shortages spark global procurement war rooms and 10x price hikes
Netherlands seeks to block US MATCH Act restricting ASML China sales
Z.ai misses GLM-5.5 launch as US rules and distillation curbs hit China AI

themes.title: Enterprise platforms update AI agent policies
themes.text: SAP is preparing to eliminate at least 10,000 positions to shift its business toward artificial intelligence. Google mandated MCP server access for Workspace AI agents starting February 2027, and OpenAI fixed a launch-day billing error that caused users to hit plan limits faster.

stories.headline: SAP prepares plan to eliminate at least 10,000 positions for AI shift
Google mandates MCP server access for Workspace AI agents by February 2027
OpenAI fixes billing error, usage limits hit 40% faster on Astra, 25% faster on Sol

themes.title: State actors and researchers expose AI risks
themes.text: State-backed hacking groups from China and North Korea have integrated the AI-powered penetration testing tool Artex into their workflows. Separately, confidential data sent to Chinese startup MiniMax was accessed by unidentified parties.

stories.headline: China and North Korean state-backed hackers add AI tool Artex to their arsenals
Confidential data sent to Chinese AI startup MiniMax accessed by unknown parties

themes.title: India advances domestic models and regulations
themes.text: India's Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology announced that upcoming AI regulation papers are in their final stages. The announcement coincided with the launch of the Chariot-1 model suite and BharatGen's Patram 1.5 vision-language model.

stories.headline: IndiaAI regulation papers in final stages and releasing soon: MeitY
BharatGen launches Patram 1.5, a 7B vision-language model for documents
Chariot AI unveils Chariot-1 LLM and speech models under IndiaAI Mission
